# Manual: https://zsh.sourceforge.io/Doc/Release/Parameters.html#Subscript-Flags
# Issue #540: the subscript closes at the `]`, and its text, expanded as a
# string, leaves the second backquote open. Top level; zsh -f -n reports:
# failed to find end of command substitution.
print $x[(r)a[b]'`'`echo "]"`
